review: Independent adversarial review: Push preflight with identity guard (#32)
scope: Confirmed production parser/RepoTab dispatch regressions and original pre-push hook semantics; interrupted before completion of remaining review. No merge approval.

findings.title: Central interception disables existing remote deletion and combined-operation undo/redo
findings.reproduction: reviewer_production_dispatch_push_matrix constructs existing UI operations, sends them through RepoTab::run_ops or actual undo/redo entry points, and receives PushError; executing the same original operation via production run_steps against a fixture bare remote succeeds.
findings.impact: Previously available branch/tag deletion and remote restoration are unusable. Unsupported-delete documentation does not preserve existing UI behavior.
findings.required_fix: Support deliberate pinned deletion and ordered local/remote operation sequences with their original lease, failure and journal semantics. Add actual dispatch regressions for all affected paths.

findings.title: Tag pushes fail solely because HEAD is detached
findings.reproduction: Create annotated release tag, detach HEAD, dispatch existing push origin refs/tags/release. Preview refuses with checked-out-branch error; original run_steps push succeeds against bare fixture.
findings.impact: Existing explicit tag push is unnecessarily disabled while inspecting detached history.
findings.required_fix: Inspect explicit source refs independently of checked-out branch, while preserving stale source/checkout ownership checks.

findings.title: LFS payload is uploaded before an original rejecting pre-push hook
findings.reproduction: Create 6 MiB fixture asset, use production LFS repair and rescan, install executable pre-push hook that records invocation and exits 1, then execute approved production plan. Push fails and remote ref stays unchanged, but receiver.git/lfs/objects contains the payload.
findings.impact: An existing policy hook cannot prevent transfer of LFS content; rejected pushes can disclose/upload data.
findings.required_fix: Preserve original hook rejection semantics before any synthetic LFS upload; continue preserving exact stdin/remote/config behavior and stale-server-lease refusal.
